name: github-mcp
purpose: Repository, issue, PR and code-search access to GitHub
description: GitHub's official first-party MCP server (github/github-mcp-server). 51 tools covering repos, issues, PRs, Actions, code scanning and notifications; lets the AI read code across branches, open/update PRs, triage issues and inspect CI runs under the user's existing GitHub permissions. Most popular MCP server in the ecosystem; rate limits apply on heavy use.
install_command: claude mcp add -s user -t http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/

2. Complete GitHub OAuth in the browser on first use.
3. Optionally use a Personal Access Token with minimum scopes (read-only unless you want the agent merging).
4. Restart client and verify tools (repos, issues, PRs) appear.

connect_steps: 1. Run the npx command with the allowed directory as argument.
2. Add the block to mcp.json with command:npx, args:['-y','@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem','<dir>'].
